common_eligibility_patterns: Chapter Six (6) statutory clearances for public sector / parastatal roles (KRA TCC, HELB, EACC, DCI Police Clearance, CRB)
Active practicing certificate with EBK, ICPAK, NCK, KMPDC, LSK, or IHRM
Current and expected gross salary (KES) often requested on application portals
scam_red_flags: Upfront recruitment, agency, or medical fees
Free email domains claiming to be UN Gigiri, Safaricom, major banks, or county governments
